Complete Guide to Protect PDF

Sending sensitive financial audits, proprietary intellectual property, employee salary statements, or confidential legal briefs over email without encryption exposes your data to interception and unauthorized access. TECHTIS Protect PDF enables you to apply strong password protection to any PDF document in seconds.

Unlike cloud-based PDF lockers that require you to send both your file and your confidential password over the internet to remote servers, TECHTIS performs cryptographic encryption directly inside your web browser. Your password never leaves your device, eliminating data breach risks.

Once encrypted, the file cannot be viewed, printed, or extracted by unauthorized parties without entering the correct password in any standard PDF reader worldwide.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Protect PDF and privacy

How to encrypt a PDF with password locally before emailing it?
Upload your document to TECHTIS Protect PDF. Enter your desired password, confirm it, and select encryption strength (standard or strong 256-bit AES). Click 'Encrypt PDF' to download your locked file. No passwords or files ever touch an external server.
Are my passwords or files sent to any remote server?
No! All encryption algorithms execute directly inside your web browser's RAM using client-side WebAssembly cryptography. Zero bytes leave your device.
What is the difference between a User Password and an Owner Password?
A User Password (Open Password) is required to open and view the document. An Owner Password (Permissions Password) restricts printing, copying text, or editing form fields even if the file can be viewed.
Can anyone open my encrypted PDF without the password?
No. Documents protected with standard AES encryption cannot be opened without entering the correct password, ensuring military-grade confidentiality.
Can I protect PDFs on my iPhone, Android, or Mac?
Yes! TECHTIS runs locally in all modern mobile and desktop browsers with zero app installation.
Is there any file size limit for encrypting PDFs?
No artificial limits exist. You can encrypt large files containing hundreds of pages without subscription fees or daily quotas.
Does TECHTIS keep a copy of my password?
Never. TECHTIS does not maintain user accounts or databases. Your password is used purely in transient browser memory to calculate encryption keys.
Will encrypting a PDF reduce image resolution or document formatting?
No. Encryption only secures the underlying byte streams using cryptographic algorithms without altering visual layout or image resolution.
